Handle Telnyx Call Control webhook events.

Telnyx sends all call lifecycle events (call.initiated, call.answered,
call.hangup, streaming.started, streaming.stopped) as JSON POST requests.

Invalid-signature requests are answered with the same 404 "Workflow run
not found" as unknown run ids, deliberately: run ids are sequential
integers, so a distinct 401 on existing runs would let unsigned callers
enumerate which runs exist. The trade-off is that a misconfigured
``webhook_public_key`` presents as a 404 to the caller; the
``logger.warning`` below carries the real reason for operators.

When ``TELEPHONY_WS_TOKEN_SECRET`` is configured, the events webhook URL
minted by the provider carries an HMAC capability token in its query
string (Telnyx preserves query strings on webhook POSTs, unlike media
stream URLs, verified live). The token is verified before any database
lookup, so the reject path does constant work and the run-existence
distinction is closed for both status code and timing. With no secret
configured, the flow falls back to the lookup-then-verify order above.

Handle Telnyx Call Control events for the transfer destination leg.

The destination leg is dialed by :meth:`TelnyxProvider.transfer_call` with
this URL as ``webhook_url``. Telnyx sends every event for that leg here.
Outcomes:

- ``call.answered``: seed a conference with the destination's live
  ``call_control_id``, stamp ``conference_id`` onto the TransferContext,
  and publish ``DESTINATION_ANSWERED`` so ``transfer_call_handler`` can
  end the pipeline. ``TelnyxConferenceStrategy`` then joins the caller
  into this conference at pipeline teardown.
- ``call.hangup`` pre-answer (no ``conference_id`` on the context):
  publish ``TRANSFER_FAILED`` so the LLM can recover.
- ``call.hangup`` post-answer (``conference_id`` set): the destination
  left a bridged conference; hang up the caller's leg to tear down the
  empty bridge (Telnyx's create_conference doesn't accept
  ``end_conference_on_exit`` on the seed leg).

Event references:
    - call.answered: https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/callbacks/call-answered
    - call.hangup:   https://developers.telnyx.com/api-reference/callbacks/call-hangup

schema.description:
JSON-encoded array of filter objects. Each object has the shape:

```json
{ "attribute": "<name>", "type": "<type>", "value": <value> }
```

Supported `attribute` / `type` / `value` combinations:

| attribute       | type          | value shape                                  | matches                                              |
|-----------------|---------------|----------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `runId`         | `number`      | `{ "value": 12345 }`                         | exact run id                                         |
| `workflowId`    | `number`      | `{ "value": 42 }`                            | exact agent (workflow) id                            |
| `campaignId`    | `number`      | `{ "value": 7 }`                             | exact campaign id                                    |
| `callerNumber`  | `text`        | `{ "value": "415555" }`                      | substring match on `initial_context.caller_number`   |
| `calledNumber`  | `text`        | `{ "value": "9911848" }`                     | substring match on `initial_context.called_number`   |
| `dispositionCode` | `multiSelect` | `{ "codes": ["XFER", "DNC"] }`             | any of the codes in `gathered_context.mapped_call_disposition` |
| `duration`      | `numberRange` | `{ "min": 60, "max": 300 }`                  | call duration (seconds), inclusive bounds            |
| `callDirection` | `radio`       | `{ "status": "inbound" }`                    | `inbound` or `outbound`; any other value matches all |
| `callChannel`   | `radio`       | `{ "status": "telephony" }`                  | `telephony`, `web`, `chat`, `simulated` (the group of run modes for that channel) or `site` (started from the site widget) |
| `judgeNote`     | `numberRange` | `{ "min": 3.5, "max": 5 }`                   | the judge's grade out of 5 (unjudged calls never match) |
| `agentVersion`  | `number`      | `{ "value": 3 }`                             | calls handled by that version number of their agent  |
| `callReason`    | `text`        | `{ "value": "Rendez-vous" }`                 | the call reason of the record, exact match (case and extra spaces ignored) |
| `callClient`    | `text`        | `{ "value": "dupont" }`                      | substring of the caller's name or number             |

Unknown attributes and unsupported `type` values are silently ignored.

Date filtering on this endpoint is done via the dedicated `start_date` / `end_date` query params, not via a `dateRange` filter object.

get.description:
In-flight call count for THIS worker — the drain signal for deploys.

A deploy orchestrator polls this per worker and waits for zero before
sending SIGTERM, because uvicorn force-closes live call WebSockets (close
code 1012) on SIGTERM and would cut calls mid-conversation otherwise. The
count is per-process: one uvicorn per VM port (scripts/rolling_update.sh)
or per Kubernetes pod (preStop hook). See api/services/observability/active_calls.py.

Fleet-wide autoscaling signal for KEDA: total active calls + warm buffer.

Unlike /health/active-calls (a per-worker drain signal), this is the whole
fleet's active-call count read from Redis, so a single scrape drives the
ScaledObject. ``buffer`` (query param, in calls) is the warm headroom: KEDA
divides value by the per-pod target K, giving desiredPods =
ceil((calls + buffer) / K). All scaling policy — K, buffer, min/max — lives
in the ScaledObject; this endpoint is pure signal.

When the fleet count cannot be read (Redis down) this responds 503, NOT 0:
a failed scrape makes KEDA's HPA hold the current replica count, while a
successful scrape of 0 would instruct it to scale toward minReplicas.

endpointing.title: Endpointing

mark_aide.en: Silence, in milliseconds, after which Deepgram declares the speech finished. Deepgram's own default is 10 ms; 100 ms is the value that was hardcoded before this field existed. Deepgram also accepts 'false' to switch endpointing off entirely, which this field does not offer.

Trop bas, l'agent coupe l'appelant ; trop haut, il laisse un blanc. Le défaut de Deepgram est 10 ms ; 100 ms est la valeur qui était fixée dans le code avant ce réglage. Deepgram accepte aussi « false » pour couper entièrement la détection de fin de parole, ce que ce réglage ne propose pas.

TransferAgentConfig.title: TransferAgentConfig
TransferAgentConfig.description:
Configuration for Transfer Agent tools.

One tool, one destination. An agent that can hand the caller to several
places gets several of these tools, and the model chooses between them the
way it chooses between any other tools -- by their names and descriptions.
That keeps the routing decision in the one place the model already reasons
about, and leaves nothing to configure here but where the call goes.

Most of how a handoff sounds is fixed: the caller hears a ringer while the
next agent is prepared. The handover line is configurable because it is
caller-facing and Dograh runs in more than one language, and so is whether
the next agent opens with its greeting, because an agent that greets
callers on its own number should not re-introduce itself mid-conversation.

user_speech_timeout.title: User Speech Timeout
user_speech_timeout.description: Seconds the caller may pause before the agent takes the floor. The single setting that most decides whether the agent cuts people off or leaves a silence. Pipecat has never had a screen for it: 0.6 s is its own default, chosen by nobody here.

stt_ttfs_p99_latency.title: Stt Ttfs P99 Latency
stt_ttfs_p99_latency.description: Seconds the pipeline allows the transcription to deliver its final text after the caller stops. Empty means the value Pipecat measured for the provider (0.35 s for Deepgram). ⚠️ That measurement was taken with a voice detector set to 0.2 s: change the detector below without this, and the end of turn is wrong.

user_turn_stop_timeout.title: User Turn Stop Timeout
user_turn_stop_timeout.description: Hard ceiling on the wait for a transcript before the turn ends anyway. Empty means the value the pipeline picks for this agent: 5 s normally, 30 s when the transcription service drives the turns itself. ⛔ This setting has TWO defaults, not one -- writing 5 s into it silently cuts a Flux agent from 30 s to 5 s.

turn_wait_for_transcript.title: Turn Wait For Transcript
turn_wait_for_transcript.description: Require at least one transcript before ending the caller's turn. Turn it off and the agent answers on silence alone, faster but on nothing that was understood.

turn_start_use_interim.title: Turn Start Use Interim
turn_start_use_interim.description: Let partial transcripts, not just final ones, confirm that the caller has started speaking.

vad_confidence.title: Vad Confidence
vad_confidence.description: How sure the voice detector must be that it is hearing speech. Higher misses quiet speech; lower takes background noise for a caller.

vad_start_secs.title: Vad Start Secs
vad_start_secs.description: Seconds of sound before the detector calls it speech. Range is ours: Pipecat sets no bound.

vad_stop_secs.title: Vad Stop Secs
vad_stop_secs.description: Seconds of silence before the detector calls the speech over. ⚠️ Tied to the transcription latency above, which was measured at 0.2 s. Range is ours: Pipecat sets no bound.

vad_min_volume.title: Vad Min Volume
vad_min_volume.description: Volume below which sound is not considered speech.

smart_turn_pre_speech_ms.title: Smart Turn Pre Speech Ms
smart_turn_pre_speech_ms.description: Milliseconds of audio kept before the caller starts speaking, for the Smart Turn model. Only used when end of turn is set to Smart Turn.

smart_turn_max_duration_secs.title: Smart Turn Max Duration Secs
smart_turn_max_duration_secs.description: Longest audio segment the Smart Turn model examines. Only used when end of turn is set to Smart Turn.

audio_idle_timeout.title: Audio Idle Timeout
audio_idle_timeout.description: Seconds without any audio at all before the caller is considered to have stopped speaking, for instance if they mute their microphone mid-sentence. 0 disables it.

filter_incomplete_user_turns.title: Filter Incomplete User Turns
filter_incomplete_user_turns.description: Ask the model itself whether the caller has finished their sentence. ⚠️ Off by default: it costs one extra model call per turn, it has not been checked against Mistral, and its follow-up prompts are in English in Pipecat. ⚠️ Deprecated upstream: it will disappear on a Pipecat major upgrade.

incomplete_short_timeout.title: Incomplete Short Timeout
incomplete_short_timeout.description: Seconds before prompting when the model judged the caller was cut off mid-sentence. Only used when the setting above is on.

incomplete_long_timeout.title: Incomplete Long Timeout
incomplete_long_timeout.description: Seconds before prompting when the model judged the caller asked for time to think. Only used when the setting above is on.

relance_tour_vide.title: Relance Tour Vide
relance_tour_vide.description: When the caller cut the agent off and nothing was transcribed (a cough, noise, speech the transcription missed), the model is told so once and asks the caller to repeat. Pipecat 1.12 turns this on by default; off (default here): nothing is said, the behaviour of before. ⚠️ Pipecat's instruction is in English and sent with the developer role (converted to user for Mistral).

user_idle_prompt.title: User Idle Prompt
user_idle_prompt.description: What the agent is told to do when the caller goes quiet. ⚠️ An instruction given to the model, not a sentence spoken word for word: the model answers in the caller's language.
user_idle_prompt.default: The user has been quiet. Politely and briefly ask if they're still there in the language that the user has been speaking so far.

user_idle_goodbye_prompt.title: User Idle Goodbye Prompt
user_idle_goodbye_prompt.description: What the agent is told to do on the last prompt, just before the call is hung up. Same thing: an instruction, not a script.
user_idle_goodbye_prompt.default: The user has been quiet. We will be disconnecting the call now. Wish them a good day in the language that the user has been speaking so far.

user_idle_max_prompts.title: User Idle Max Prompts
user_idle_max_prompts.description: How many times the agent checks whether the caller is still there before saying goodbye and hanging up. 0 hangs up on the first silence, with the goodbye.

audio_in_noise_filter.title: Audio In Noise Filter
audio_in_noise_filter.description: Clean the caller's audio before it is transcribed. RNNoise is free and runs locally. ⚠️ A noise filter can just as easily get in the transcription's way: it is judged on a real phone line, not on a browser call.

conversion_nombres_transcription.title: Conversion Nombres Transcription
conversion_nombres_transcription.description: Rewrites the numbers the caller dictates as digits before the model reads them, and reads postal codes said both ways ("soixante sept cent quarante", "soixante mille sept cent quarante"), amounts and invoice or quote references. The recorded transcript keeps the caller's words. French only. No effect in realtime mode.

verification_communes.title: Verification Communes
verification_communes.description: Matches the town the caller names against the official list of French communes before the model reads it. Acts only at steps that collect a `commune` or `adresse…` variable. No effect in realtime mode.

sons_communes.title: Sons Communes
sons_communes.description: Compares how the heard words sound with how each town sounds (pronunciation library), in addition to the spelling. Off: spelling only.

verification_voies.title: Verification Voies
verification_voies.description: Matches the street the caller names against the streets of their commune in the national address base, and tells the model the name to use. Needs the town check: without a commune there is no list of streets to search. Acts at the same steps. A street that is not found is spelled out once, never asked again. No effect in realtime mode.

lecture_epellation.title: Lecture Epellation
lecture_epellation.description: Reads the letters a caller spells out ("f l a m a n t", "F comme François", "deux T", accents, e-mail addresses) and tells the model to copy them exactly. Acts at every step: a name, a street, a brand or an address can be spelled at any moment. No effect in realtime mode.

sons_lexique.title: Sons Lexique
sons_lexique.description: Compares how the heard words sound with how each name of the trade vocabulary sounds, in addition to the spelling. A name found by its sound alone is asked for confirmation. Off: spelling only.

lexique_metier.title: Lexique Metier
lexique_metier.description: Uses the organization's trade vocabulary: listens for the ticked terms, corrects misheard names before the model reads them, and applies their pronunciations to the voice. No effect in realtime mode.

variables_commune.title: Variables Commune
variables_commune.description: The extraction variables that trigger the town check, separated by commas. A final * means every name that starts with it (adresse* covers adresse_chantier). Case and spaces do not count. Empty: commune, commune_*, adresse*.

variables_reference.title: Variables Reference
variables_reference.description: The extraction variables that trigger the reference reader (invoice, quote or order numbers), same format as above. Empty: reference*.

controle_donnees.title: Controle Donnees
controle_donnees.description: Checks the data: during the call, a phone number dictated with 9 or 11 digits is signalled to the model at a step that collects a phone; at the end of the call the record is checked (phone, postcode and town, e-mail, date, empty fields of the steps the call went through) and the verdict written with the call. Never changes a value. Off: as before.

variables_telephone.title: Variables Telephone
variables_telephone.description: Phone fields, same format as the town variables. Empty: the default.

variables_code_postal.title: Variables Code Postal
variables_code_postal.description: Postcode fields, same format. Empty: the default.

variables_courriel.title: Variables Courriel
variables_courriel.description: E-mail fields, same format. Empty: the default.

variables_date.title: Variables Date
variables_date.description: Date fields, same format. Empty: the default.

horaires_ouverture.title: Horaires Ouverture
horaires_ouverture.description: Opening hours in the readable French format. Computes etat_ouverture, reouverture, horaires_ouverture and annonce_ouverture at call start. The last one is the sentence to say when picking up, empty when the business is reachable; use it in the start node greeting as {{initial_context.annonce_ouverture}}. Empty: nothing is computed.

adresse_etablissement.description: Business address for this agent. Leave empty to use the organization's address. Given to the agent as {{adresse_etablissement}}; the street is not used to recognise towns.

mute_until_first_bot_complete.title: Mute Until First Bot Complete
mute_until_first_bot_complete.description: Keep the caller from interrupting the agent's opening sentence. On until now, and this is the one that keeps a greeting from being cut in half by a hello.

accueil_interruptible.title: Accueil Interruptible
accueil_interruptible.description: Let the caller cut the agent's greeting by speaking. Off: the greeting is always heard to the end, as until now. On: the protection of the opening sentence above is lifted for this agent, and the greeting stops once the caller has said the number of words below.

accueil_mots_minimum.title: Accueil Mots Minimum
accueil_mots_minimum.description: How many words the caller must say to cut the greeting. Only used when the switch above is on. 2 keeps a cough or a lone 'hello' from cutting it.

raccrochage_silence_agent_s.title: Raccrochage Silence Agent S
raccrochage_silence_agent_s.description: Seconds the call waits for the agent's answer, with no sound at all, before hanging up. Protects the caller from a frozen agent. While a tool runs, the wait is 180 s whatever this says.

mute_during_function_call.title: Mute During Function Call
mute_during_function_call.description: Keep the caller from interrupting while the agent is running a tool, such as a transfer or a lookup.

mute_engine_callback.title: Mute Engine Callback
mute_engine_callback.description: Follow the workflow's own rule about which nodes may be interrupted. ⚠️ Turning it off ignores every 'do not interrupt' set on a node, and does it silently.

mute_first_speech.title: Mute First Speech
mute_first_speech.description: Keep the caller from interrupting during the agent's very first utterance. Narrower than the first setting above, and never used until now.

mute_always.title: Mute Always
mute_always.description: The caller can never interrupt the agent at all. ⚠️ On a phone call this is usually the wrong answer: someone who has to wait out a whole answer hangs up.

tts_push_silence_after_stop.title: Tts Push Silence After Stop
tts_push_silence_after_stop.description: Add a moment of silence after the agent finishes speaking. Off today, which is why the duration below currently changes nothing. Useful where a phone line clips the last syllable.

tts_silence_time_s.title: Tts Silence Time S
tts_silence_time_s.description: How long that silence lasts. ⚠️ Only used when the switch above is on.

tts_text_aggregation_mode.title: Tts Text Aggregation Mode
tts_text_aggregation_mode.description: Send the text to the voice sentence by sentence, or word by word as the model writes it. Word by word answers sooner, but it can degrade the voice depending on the provider: judge it by ear.

interdire_nom_appelant.title: Interdire Nom Appelant
interdire_nom_appelant.description: Stop the agent from SAYING the caller's family name out loud. Enforced in code rather than by the prompt, which never held: five rewrites in two days still left the name spoken in 2 voice runs out of 5. ⚠️ Only works when the text is sent to the voice sentence by sentence (see the aggregation mode above): word by word, a name is split across frames and the filter stays inert. The name is still written to the call record and the transcript -- this filters what is spoken, never what is noted. A SPELLED name is deliberately left alone, so have the agent confirm a name by spelling it, never by saying it.

blocs_mode.title: Blocs Mode
blocs_mode.description: [.mark] Reusable blocks ({{bloc:x}} without @vN): follow the latest proven version live ('direct') or freeze it at publication ('fige'). Empty: frozen on a protected agent, live otherwise. A change applies from the next publication.

blocs_modes.title: Blocs Modes
blocs_modes.description: [.mark] The same choice for one block of this agent (by slug); it overrides the agent's choice.

securite_conversation.description: [.mark] The safety of the conversation, three layers, all generic and each with a switch, all off by default: safety instructions added after the prompt (manipulation, confidentiality, role, vital emergency); two guards on the reply before the voice (a tool name, braces, brackets and {{...}} removed; a reply that copies N consecutive words of the agent's own instructions replaced); a classifier of the caller, in parallel, never awaited. Same behaviour by phone and by keyboard.

interdire_civilite_appelant.title: Interdire Civilite Appelant
interdire_civilite_appelant.description: Stop the agent from saying Monsieur, Madame or Mademoiselle. Same mechanism and same limits as the switch above. Independent of it: either can be used alone.

relecture_des_numeros.title: Relecture Des Numeros
relecture_des_numeros.description: Before the voice, a phone number the agent reads back is compared with the last number the caller dictated, as read by our number reader; if a digit differs, the caller's digits are spoken instead. Only phone numbers, sentence by sentence. Off (default): the agent's read-back as written.

laisser_la_parole.title: Laisser La Parole
laisser_la_parole.description: When the caller asks for a moment (to look something up or check), the arbiter recognises it on their words and the code grants the wait; the agent answers as usual. While it waits, the silence reminder is replaced by a gentle sentence (a rule of the sentence catalogue, with its own delay, default 45 s) and the call is never hung up on silence. The caller speaking again lifts the wait. No tool is offered to the agent. Off (default): the question is not asked.

fiche_dans_le_systeme.title: Fiche Dans Le Systeme
fiche_dans_le_systeme.description: Where the record's state (what is noted, what is still expected) is shown to the model. Off (default): as a message of the caller, just before their last words. On: at the end of the system instruction, rebuilt for every request, which is where the model takes its orders (measured: a model that asked again for what the record held read it there). Works with any model.

fiche_forme_courte.title: Fiche Forme Courte
fiche_forme_courte.description: How much the model is told along with the record's state. Off (default): the block as before, with its instructions ("do not ask again", "let the caller choose"). On: the data lines only (what is noted, what is still expected, what the modules read) under a one-line heading; the instructions are the prompt's own. Works with any model.

prechauffer_les_collegues.title: Prechauffer Les Collegues
prechauffer_les_collegues.description: Whether the colleagues' prompts are read ahead. Off (default): nothing changes. On: at the start of the call, one minimal request per colleague of the group (one token asked, nothing said, nothing written in the conversation) carries the colleague's entry prompt with the agent's cache key, so that the real first request finds the start of that prompt already read and the handoff is shorter. Needs the colleagues to be preloaded (on by default in a group). Works with any model; a provider without a cache just receives an ordinary small request.

reconnaitre_un_outil_ecrit.title: Reconnaitre Un Outil Ecrit
reconnaitre_un_outil_ecrit.description: What happens when the model's whole reply is only the name of one of its tools (bare or dressed up: underscores, italics, punctuation, arguments). Off (default): the reply is kept as written. On: the reply becomes the call of that tool, never spoken and never kept in the history. A reply that holds real text besides the name is never touched. Works with any model.

signaler_un_probleme.title: Signaler Un Probleme
signaler_un_probleme.description: Offers the agent a tool to flag, silently, that it is lost (an ambiguous request, a rule it does not know, a failing tool): a short reason and a category. Nothing is said to the caller and the call goes on; two flags at most per call. The flags are read after the call in the « To triage » page. Off (default): the tool is not offered.

alertes_par_mail.title: Alertes Par Mail
alertes_par_mail.description: At the end of a call that raised alerts (call ended in error, tool failure, transfer failed), sends ONE grouped mail to the organization's notification addresses and to .mark's. The alerts are always listed in the « Alerts » page; without a mail server the mail is simply not sent. Off (default): no mail.

generer_schema_parcours.title: Generer Schema Parcours
generer_schema_parcours.description: At every save, write the flow map at the end of the global prompt: each step with its role (the line under « # Ta mission ici » of its prompt). Clerk mode with transitions in the reply: during the call, each step ends with one block (where the agent is, how to move on, each way out with its condition and arrival sentence) and the note-taking block is dropped. Other modes: 'Tu es ici' with the step's name at the end of each step's prompt. The blocks are replaced at each save, never stacked. Off: blocks left by an earlier save are removed, nothing else changes.

empecher_boucles.title: Empecher Boucles
empecher_boucles.description: [.mark] Forbid loops between the steps of the graph: linking two steps so that a cycle closes is refused, and the cycles already there are pointed out. Off by default. It guards the DRAWING of the graph; the call engine is unchanged.

fiche_au_fil_de_leau.title: Fiche Au Fil De Leau
fiche_au_fil_de_leau.description: Give the model a noter_information tool it can call at any step to write or correct a field of the call record below. Off: the tool is not offered at all and the agent behaves exactly as before. On: the step-by-step extraction is switched off, the record is filled by the tool. No effect in realtime mode.

fiche_mode_de_note.title: Fiche Mode De Note
fiche_mode_de_note.description: How the call record is written, when it is on. Tool (default): the model calls noter_information, then speaks in a second pass. Postscript: the model speaks, then writes its note after a separator in the same answer; the note is never spoken. Clerk: a second model keeps the record alongside the agent, the agent only speaks.

relance_apres_outil.title: Relance Apres Outil
relance_apres_outil.description: Pipecat ticket 5960. When a tool result reaches the agent before the caller's turn has closed, the model's reply is kept and sent once the turn closes, instead of being lost (the agent then stays silent until the caller speaks again). Off (default): Pipecat's behaviour. No effect in realtime mode.

portes_dans_la_reponse.title: Portes Dans La Reponse
portes_dans_la_reponse.description: Postscript and Clerk modes. The agent takes a transition inside its reply and already speaks the next step's first reply: no silence between steps. Off (default): transitions stay function calls, as before.

ordre_de_la_reponse.title: Ordre De La Reponse
ordre_de_la_reponse.description: Postscript only. 'porte_note_phrase': the agent writes its note before its sentence, so the sentence knows what was just noted (no question asked again). 'porte_phrase_note' (default): the sentence first, then the note.

etiquettes_des_etapes.title: Etiquettes Des Etapes
etiquettes_des_etapes.description: Each step lists the record fields it gathers, in order of priority; at each turn the code reminds the model of the next missing ones, as a suggestion it may set aside. Every note-taking mode. Off (default): the steps' field lists are kept but nothing is shown to the model.

filet_de_fin.title: Filet De Fin
filet_de_fin.description: Safety net for a specialised agent: when its reply holds a closing phrase ("goodbye", "have a nice day"...) and it took no exit, the code takes the exit that hands the call back to the main agent, which closes the call. The phrases are the organization's "formules_de_fin" sentence. Off (default): nothing is done, as before.

fiche_deja_connu.title: Fiche Deja Connu
fiche_deja_connu.description: Next to the question, a short line names the record fields already known (names only, never the values): "Known: name, first name, town". Every note-taking mode. Off (default): nothing is shown.

transfert_garanti.title: Transfert Garanti
transfert_garanti.description: When the agent arrives in a step that carries a call transfer tool and the business is OPEN, the code launches the transfer itself once the step's first reply has been said, instead of waiting for the model to call it. Every note-taking mode. Off (default): the model decides, as before.

verite_formulations_d_action.title: Verite Formulations D Action
verite_formulations_d_action.description: Past participles that say an action is done (booked, confirmed, cancelled...), checked by the « Truth of actions » box of the steps: a reply that says one of them with no tool result behind it is held back and the model asked again once. Empty (default): the built-in list. Needs the call record.

trace_requetes_modele.title: Trace Requetes Modele
trace_requetes_modele.description: Test agents only (Agent theme, Diagnostic). About 20 KB per answer. Each answer the conversation model is asked for is recorded in the run (requetes_modele): the exact request (messages, tools, settings, never a key), every piece of the stream with its finish reason and arrival time, the token count, how the stream ended, and what was spoken. Off (default): nothing is recorded and nothing changes.

reflexion_de_relance.title: Reflexion De Relance
reflexion_de_relance.description: OpenAI-compatible provider, Clerk mode with transitions in the reply (Agent theme). When an answer ends in the middle of a sentence, it is never spoken and the model answers once more; that single retry is sent with this reasoning effort (e.g. 'low' when the agent runs with 'none'). Empty (default): the retry uses the agent's usual setting.

phrase_sans_redemande.title: Phrase Sans Redemande
phrase_sans_redemande.description: Postscript, 'note, sentence' order only. When the note of a turn has written a record field and the sentence asks for that same field again, the sentence is not spoken and the model answers once more. The sentence then waits for its end before it is spoken. When unsure, the sentence is spoken. Off (default): nothing changes.

indices_des_modules.title: Indices Des Modules
indices_des_modules.description: Postscript and clerk modes. Our data readers (list values, trade names, towns, numbers, spellings) tell the model what they recognised in the caller's last words; nothing is written in the record. Empty: on in Postscript ('note, sentence' order), off otherwise.

moteur_sorties_de_l_etape.title: Moteur Sorties De L Etape
moteur_sorties_de_l_etape.description: For each exit of the step, a line tells the model the first thing still missing in the arrival step (the code picks the next question, the model words it). Needs the « known and expected » box. Off: those lines are not written.

moteur_sortie_d_impasse.title: Moteur Sortie D Impasse
moteur_sortie_d_impasse.description: The dead-end guard: counts the signs of a conversation going round in circles, shows the model its two notices, then at the third time says the dead-end sentence and changes step. Off: nothing is counted, shown or done.

moteur_parole_avant_outil.title: Moteur Parole Avant Outil
moteur_parole_avant_outil.description: A tool that returns at once does not wake the model again when the same answer had already spoken before calling it. Off: the model is always woken after such a tool (it may repeat its sentence).

moteur_main_passee.title: Moteur Main Passee
moteur_main_passee.description: Around a handover: the agent that passed the call on stops answering, and a request that ends on the assistant gets the handover note. Off: neither. ⚠️ Depends on the handover: the previous agent may speak over the new one, and the provider may refuse the request.

moteur_ordre_outil_puis_parole.title: Moteur Ordre Outil Puis Parole
moteur_ordre_outil_puis_parole.description: In the copy of the request sent to the model, the sentence said before a tool is moved after the result of the tool, so the caller never follows a tool result directly. Off: the order is sent as recorded (some providers refuse it).

moteur_compte_rendu_de_phrase.title: Moteur Compte Rendu De Phrase
moteur_compte_rendu_de_phrase.description: After a sentence said by the code, the model receives in the tool result a short report in French (what happened, what the caller heard, what is noted, what is no longer possible). Off: no report. ⚠️ Without it the model may repeat the sentence the caller just heard.

moteur_phrases_coupees.title: Moteur Phrases Coupees
moteur_phrases_coupees.description: A sentence of the code the caller cut off is rewritten in the request sent to the model, so it knows what was actually heard. Off: the request carries the full sentence.

moteur_replique_inachevee.title: Moteur Replique Inachevee
moteur_replique_inachevee.description: Clerk mode with transitions in the reply. A reply that ends in the middle of a sentence is not spoken to its end nor kept, and the model answers once more. Off: the reply is spoken as it stands.

moteur_reponse_muette.title: Moteur Reponse Muette
moteur_reponse_muette.description: Clerk mode with transitions in the reply. A reply with no sentence and no transition (only a note, for instance) makes the model answer once more. Off: the turn stays silent.

moteur_notes_de_passation.title: Moteur Notes De Passation
moteur_notes_de_passation.description: Group of agents. The code writes a handover note in the prompt of the step that opens (return of the main agent, first step of a colleague). Off: the prompt is left as written. ⚠️ The colleague no longer knows what is already noted.

greffier_llm.title: Greffier Llm
greffier_llm.description: The clerk's model, when the note-taking mode is Clerk: provider, model, settings and its own API key. Empty fields come from the conversation model; an empty key uses the conversation's key (and its rate limit).

arbitre_llm.title: Arbitre Llm
arbitre_llm.description: The arbiter's model (the separate small model that decides, in parallel, whether the conversation calls for an exit of the step): provider, model, settings and its own API key. Empty: the clerk's model, else the conversation model. An empty key uses the conversation's key (and its rate limit).

greffier_consigne.title: Greffier Consigne
greffier_consigne.description: The clerk's instructions. Empty: the generic instructions written in the code. The record's fields and the expected answer format are always added by the code.

travail_actif.title: Travail Actif
travail_actif.description: Background work. On: the agent can hand a request to a second brain that works with tools while the conversation goes on, then gets its result back. Off (default): nothing changes.

travail_llm.title: Travail Llm
travail_llm.description: The background brain's model: provider, model, settings and its own API key. Empty fields come from the conversation model; an empty key uses the conversation's key.

travail_consigne.title: Travail Consigne
travail_consigne.description: The background brain's instructions. Empty (default): none are added by the code, to be written with the team.

travail_outils.title: Travail Outils
travail_outils.description: The tools the background brain may use (tool UUIDs of the organization). Call transfers and the end of the call are never given to it.

travail_delai_max_s.title: Travail Delai Max S
travail_delai_max_s.description: How long the background brain may work on one request, in seconds.

delai_garde_modele_s.title: Delai Garde Modele S
delai_garde_modele_s.description: Model guard delay: past it without the model's first words, the code says its « model is slow » sentence and tries again (at the fallback brain if one is set). Empty: 4 s.

cerveau_de_repli.title: Cerveau De Repli
cerveau_de_repli.description: Fallback brain, a troubleshooting tool, never part of a standard setup: when the model is past its guard delay, the second try goes to this model (an OpenAI-compatible provider), with the agent's tools and record. Empty (default): none.

travail_llm_repli.title: Travail Llm Repli
travail_llm_repli.description: Fallback brain of the background brain (troubleshooting only). Empty: none.

cerveau_plafond_prompt.title: Cerveau Plafond Prompt
cerveau_plafond_prompt.description: Largest prompt (in characters) the brain handles well. A longer prompt is only a warning at publication. Empty: no threshold, the check stays silent.

cerveau_poids_max.title: Cerveau Poids Max
cerveau_poids_max.description: Heaviest reply (general prompt + step prompt + conditions of its exits, in characters) the brain handles well. Above it a step is only flagged. Empty: no threshold, the weight is shown as a plain figure.

phrases_regles.title: Phrases Regles
phrases_regles.description: Sentences said by the code, without the model: one rule per cause and place (group, agent or step), one to three sentences, a delay when the cause has one.

phrases_repos_s.title: Phrases Repos S
phrases_repos_s.description: Minimum pause between two waiting sentences said by the code, in seconds (set on the main agent). Empty: 3 s, as before.

fiche_champs.title: Fiche Champs
fiche_champs.description: The fields of the call record the tool can write: name, type, dictated or deduced, and a hint for the model. A dictated value is written only if the caller said it.

tts_replacements.title: Tts Replacements
tts_replacements.description: Words the voice mispronounces, written as heard:spoken -- for instance SAV:S. A. V. Matched literally, not as a pattern, and applied to the text sent to the voice only: the conversation history keeps the original.

tts_balises_permises.title: Tts Balises Permises
tts_balises_permises.description: Expression tags allowed in the text sent to the voice, written without brackets (warm, calm, slowly, pause). Any other passage between square brackets is removed before the voice: an unknown tag can be read out loud. Empty list: every bracket is removed. Not filled in (default): the Soniox voice uses warm, calm, slowly and pause, any other voice sends its text as written. Under the Soniox voice the model itself may write a tag of this list (any other bracket it writes is removed, as before). Sentence by sentence only. Applies to the text sent to the voice. Under a voice that times each word (Soniox, ElevenLabs) the conversation history is rebuilt from what was said, so it keeps the allowed tags; brackets are never shown in the transcript or read by the call record.

tts_markdown_filter_enabled.title: Tts Markdown Filter Enabled
tts_markdown_filter_enabled.description: Strip markdown formatting before the text reaches the voice. Without it, a model that answers with **bold** has the asterisks read out loud. Does not touch parentheses: a stage direction like (one moment) is still spoken, and stays a matter for the prompt.

tts_cache_enabled.title: Tts Cache Enabled
tts_cache_enabled.description: Reuse generated speech for repeated phrases. Supports MiniMax TTS.

apres_appel.title: Apres Appel
apres_appel.description: After the call: write each call in the client's database, summarise it, mail the request, and run the organization's modules this agent uses. Empty or off: nothing is written or sent, the agent behaves exactly as before.

panne.title: Panne
panne.description: Outage fallback: when a part of the agent fails, Twilio hands the call to the establishment's second number or promises a call-back. Empty or off: as before.

equipe_connue.title: Equipe Connue
equipe_connue.description: Gives the agent the team of the establishment called, as {{equipe}}: first name, last name, role and what each person takes care of; a phone number or an e-mail only where the client allowed it. Also gives the summary the names to spell. Off: the agent knows no one, exactly as before.

verification_appelant.title: Verification Appelant
verification_appelant.description: Lets the actions « verify the caller » and « read the record » run for this agent, with the factors and levels of the organization (theme « Caller verification »). Off: they answer that verification is unavailable and nothing of a record is read.

call_dispositions.title: Call Dispositions
call_dispositions.description: Allowed business outcomes for terminal call classification. Each entry defines the exact stored code and the criteria for selecting it.

WorkflowListResponse.title: WorkflowListResponse
WorkflowListResponse.description: Lightweight response for workflow listings (excludes large fields).

phone_number.title: Phone Number
phone_number.description: Deprecated. Use caller_number and called_number instead.

client.title: Client
client.description: Who called: first and last name from the call's record.

motif.title: Motif
motif.description: The call reason from the record.

note_juge.title: Note Juge
note_juge.description: The judge's grade out of 5; null until the call is judged.

juge_par.title: Juge Par
juge_par.description: Who judged the call: the judge's model, or Claude Code; null until it is judged.

version.title: Version
version.description: The agent version that handled the call.

canal.title: Canal
canal.description: telephony, web, chat, simulated or site.

resume.title: Resume
resume.description: One or two sentences on the call: the after-call summary, else the model's short summary; null when none.

resume_source.title: Resume Source
resume_source.description: Where the summary comes from: synthese or modele.

latence.title: Latence
latence.description: Latency per turn of the call: {moyenne_ms, pire_ms, tours}; null when it was not measured.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: xAI voice persona.

mark_aide.en: xAI voice persona.
mark_aide.fr: Personnage vocal xAI.

language.title: Language
language.description: BCP-47 language code for synthesis (e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'de'), or 'auto' for automatic language detection.

mark_aide.en: BCP-47 language code for synthesis (e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'de'), or 'auto' for automatic language detection.
mark_aide.fr: Code de langue BCP-47 pour la synthèse (par exemple « en », « fr », « de »), ou « auto » pour la détection automatique de la langue.

deja_presents.title: Deja Presents
deja_presents.description: Terms left untouched: one of their spellings was already there.
